title: Bench console
description: Optional bench features of the SeaTalk bridge firmware.

keys.name: telnet
keys.title: Telnet console
keys.description: Bench console on TCP port 23. Unauthenticated: anyone on the LAN can send keys, so use it on the bench only. Uses about 5 KB RAM while on, plus about 8 KB per open session; nothing while off. Only exists in builds with CONFIG_ST_BRIDGE_TELNET; other builds ignore it.
